notes: Fixed (important): if the After Effects panel closed partway through a send and you resumed soon after, comps built before the close could lose their images (colour bars, missing files). Resuming now never touches images that existing comps use.
The After Effects panel now says when an import was cut short, and that you finish it with Resume in Figma.
Dashed lines now start and end on a half dash like Figma (the dash Offset in AE was going the wrong way).
testFocus: Close the Frame Bridge panel in After Effects partway through a send, reopen it, check it says the import didn't finish, then click Resume in Figma. Every comp should keep all its images (File ▸ Dependencies ▸ Find Missing Footage shows none).
Compare Dashed line and Dashed circle against the Figma Reference.
